findings.location: 생활 전이와 다음 장면: explain why both can be called 나무
findings.problem: EN adds learner-produced explanation where KO specifies supported confirmation with an explanation. DE shares the additional output demand.
findings.proposal: Replace EN paragraph: Find another tree or hat in a picture and add the Korean label. If you learnt the wood meaning, look at a tree photo and a photo of stacked boards side by side and review the explanation of the two meanings of 나무. Keep KO; align DE to supported review.

findings.problem: The omitted handover subject can be read as Sujin although the learner should pass her the piece.
findings.proposal: 수진이 ‘응, 그거.’라고 확인하면 내가 조각을 건넨다. / When Sujin confirms, ‘Yes, that one,’ I pass her the piece. / Wenn Sujin mit ‘Ja, genau das’ bestätigt, reiche ich ihr das Teil.

findings.location: 창고의 두 상자: As he is about to put both in the same box
findings.problem: Masculine pronouns assign Joy a sex not fixed by canon.
findings.proposal: As Joy is about to put both in the same box, Sujin points to the empty one.

findings.location: 선반 두 줄/마무리: Earlier he wanted / now he leaves / he tilts his head / he places / he asks
findings.problem: Masculine pronouns assign Joy a sex not fixed by canon.
findings.proposal: Opening: Joy looks from the left row of the shelf to the right. Earlier, Joy wanted to put all the labels together; now each has a space. When Sujin offers a label, Joy’s head tilts to one side. Closing: Joy puts down one label and looks at Sujin. When she nods, Joy places the other in the next row. ‘Kept them apart this time, didn’t I?’ Joy asks.

findings.location: 생활 전이와 다음 장면: Joy opens his wings a little
findings.problem: Masculine pronouns assign Joy a sex not fixed by canon.
findings.proposal: Seeing a broad patch of blue, Joy spreads both wings a little.
